root_cause: Portal V2 external intelligence called /api/portal-ondernemersdata without the Netlify Identity bearer token while the server-side function authenticates with getUser(). Same-origin credentials alone do not satisfy that contract.
prevention_rule: Every protected Portal V2 browser request whose Netlify function uses getUser() must reuse the active portal identity JWT and send Authorization: Bearer <jwt>; service-role credentials remain server-side.
regression_contract: portal-v2/tests/entrepreneur-intelligence-auth.test.mjs must verify the bearer header and customer-safe 401 handling before protected merge.

evidence.outcome: External-intelligence requests now use the same identity-token contract as the existing protected Portal V2 state route.

historical_replay: Before fix: /api/portal-ondernemersdata returned 401 because the request contained no Authorization bearer token.
After fix: the client obtains the current Netlify Identity JWT and attaches it to the protected source-data request.
